steps.title: Each place has 6 choices
steps.text: \[\begin{aligned}&\text{Repetition is allowed, so every one of}\\[5pt]&\text{the 4 places can take any of the 6}\\[5pt]&\text{digits.}\\[5pt]&6\times6\times6\times6=6^4\\[5pt]&\textcolor{#047857}{\mathbf{=1296}}\end{aligned}\]
